title: His Way in the Sanctuary by Pastor Stephen Bohr

videos.title: 1. His Way Is In The Sanctuary - Pastor Stephen Bohr - His Way Is In The Sanctuary
videos.description: In this series, Pastor Bohr explains how the many doctrines of the Bible, such as the divine/human nature of Christ, the salvation of sinful man, the Sabbath, the ten commandments, the state of the dead, the judgment, tithing, healthful living, the work of angels, and even end-time events, are explained in the sanctuary service. With simplicity and clarity, he shows how the sanctuary is the great magnet that draws together all the doctrines of the Bible into a unified system of truth.
